description: Parmigiana di Melanzane is a beloved Italian vegetarian classic featuring tender layers of fried or baked eggplant, rich tomato sauce, fresh basil, and a generous blend of mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses. This comforting dish bakes into a golden, bubbly masterpiece, perfect for a hearty family meal or an elegant dinner. Each bite offers a harmonious balance of savory, sweet, and cheesy flavors that truly capture the essence of Italian home cooking.

instructions.title: Prepare Eggplant
instructions.text: Slice eggplants into 1/4-inch thick rounds. Lay them on a baking sheet, sprinkle generously with salt, and let them rest for 30 minutes to draw out bitter liquids. Pat dry thoroughly with paper towels.

instructions.title: Cook Eggplant
instructions.text: Heat a generous amount of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Fry eggplant slices in batches until golden brown and tender on both sides. Alternatively, brush with olive oil and bake at 200°C (400°F) for 15-20 minutes until tender and lightly browned. Drain on paper towels.

instructions.title: Make Tomato Sauce
instructions.text: In a medium saucepan, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil. Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Pour in tomato passata, season with salt and pepper, and bring to a simmer. Cook for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened. Stir in a few basil leaves.

instructions.title: Assemble Layers
instructions.text: Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F). Spread a thin layer of tomato sauce on the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Arrange a single layer of cooked eggplant slices over the sauce. Top with a spoonful of sauce, slices of fresh mozzarella, a sprinkle of grated Parmigiano Reggiano, and a few basil leaves.

instructions.title: Build and Repeat
instructions.text: Repeat the layering process: eggplant, sauce, mozzarella, Parmigiano, and basil, until all ingredients are used, ending with a final layer of sauce and a generous amount of Parmigiano Reggiano on top.

instructions.title: Bake and Serve
instructions.text: Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until the Parmigiana is bubbling and the top is golden brown. Let it rest for at least 15-20 minutes before slicing and serving. This allows the layers to set properly, ensuring a cleaner cut and richer flavor.

tips: For a less oily version, bake the eggplant instead of frying. Brush slices with olive oil and roast at 200°C (400°F) until tender and golden.
Always use good quality fresh mozzarella and aged Parmigiano Reggiano for the best flavor. Draining the mozzarella thoroughly prevents a watery parmigiana.
Let the Parmigiana di Melanzane rest for at least 15-20 minutes after baking. This allows the cheese to set and the flavors to meld, making it easier to slice and enhancing the overall taste.
